book.name: MAREEKOO
book.title: MAREEKOOFA Yisuna amiqira fasaasa ufa Mareekoofa akara rinau.

content: Yisufa doonkisaa Yeerusaree maqusai ooru finau.

Yisufa narí faiqi namufaqa faiqí anaasee faqa Yeerusaree maqusa aaqa ooruree qaara kaqikaa maqusa nuqu Beetapaisa faqa Beetani faqa mi maqusa qanda naaqa ooruree Oorifa aaqana aaqa ooru raqau. Oorureenoo narí faiqi namukinaana qaaraqanda Yisufa narí niqiqeenoo indaaru fuaqee qimasee qimanniminau.

Inneeqara fimaria maqusafa marinaki oonureeqa fuka doonki akoona afaandama itirana saqarisaa sandannai anukaki qususee saqarisaa qusuqaafanoo marina paqurifaranoo. Sia faiqí moo fannoo mina ataufakasaa ooqu marifi fia kaqi maridanoo, innee mina sanda idukusee mi doonkina maree aniaqa.

Faiqí moo fannoo inniqarara naqi fee ida fee miqida fee qifaqa inneeqara maaqi qimasee qimamiaqa, maasa uriqararafa maa doonkina saika maridanoo taikasainanoo aaqee uqanna muqu nimiannoo fee qifaqa ani maraidaqa.

Yisufa miqi qimasee qimannimufaqa miqanda oonuree qafoofanoo doonki akoona afaandama itirana paquriqau, mifa maqusasaa moo maaqa kooqiki mari saqarinasaa qusuqoofanoo marinau. Miqanda oonu qafee iduki marufanoo akaqausa maqusasaa marusa aniree qiqau,
Naqiraree maraidee qufaqa miqanda Yisuna ufa kai qimannimufaqa doo maree fuaqee qiqau.
Miqanda mi doonkina mara maree Yisufuqoo miniseeqa nári oosana marasee nári qamunna mina ataufakaaqa ufiqisoofanoo Yisufa minasaa ooqu marifinoo Yeerusareenni ooru finau.

Faiqí anaasee moomoosa Yisuna qafamaseeqa nári karaambaiqa imaru oosanna mareeqa nári siuta raipaqueeqee aanasaa ufiqimarufaqa akaqausa saqari asaana amanee namufaqaana dinni dinni anaadookina saqari ateekeeqee aanasaa ufiqisoofanoo mi mau doonki fannoo finau. Fimarufaqa moomoosa inaaqiannai faqa oorinni faqa fidaqa maaqi qimasee faaqaridaqa asasidaqa qiqau Anutuna firaaqoo amooqiaqa.
Maasa qikoona Dafidina ququsaki marianinna karaambaiqana Anutufa amiqi amiqiani. Karaambaiqa Anutuna auqusaa Yisufa uridanoo. Anutuna firaaqoo amooqiaqa.

Miqi qidaqa afiaqa ooru fiufaqa Yeerusaree taunnaki keeqafufanoo Yisufa misa amaana maqa firaanaki keeqafufanoo aiqama ainaina aiquqiiseenoo doo rafudamakufanoo doo eendidanoommifoo qimaseenoo narí faiqi namu qisaukuqara taikasee qikunni ooqu qaara marasee nifiqamareenoo kafaa Beetani maqusai ooqu finau.
Yisufa faafisa fooqaa saqari aqinau.

Misa faiqee iqaqoofaqa Beetani maqusaindari Yisufa Yeerusareenni ooru fidanoo aararoofanoo Yisufa qafoofanoo faafisa fooqaa ira saqari nianai marufanoo qaqama iranoo fee marinoo sia fee marinoo qimaseenoo aaqa oonuree qafoofanoo amanee kai marufanoo qaqama iree maru aukuana sia marunara sia iranau.
Yisufa mina qafamaseenoo mi faafisana aqinau anee maqee maaqooqari naaru naaru anisaaqaraana sia faiqí moo fannoo ani qaqama naannoo. Miqi qu ufana Yisuna faiqi namu iriqau.
Yisufa amaana maqaki makeeti marusa niqiqanau.

Misa kafaa Yeerusaree maqusai ooru keeqafufanoo Yisufa misa amaana maqa fiqu fiqumma ququsa auquqoonaki keeqafufanoo minaki faiqí ummuari maru makeeti marusa ooru rapatutummeeqeenoo nifaqasoofaqa rafudamaki fifainiqau. Minaki marusa faiqí anaasee kaqi munnimma marasaida amaana maqakinaa munnimma faiqí anaasee nimisaidaqa minasaa qaraana ati munnimma ookaa mandee ummuaramasee maraaneera miqi mariqau. Yisufa misa qaindauqa faqa misa munnimma minasaa quqaqoonauqa faqa aiqama ooru qumaree teeqi taaqimaseenoo nakipuruna faiqí anaasee bisinisaiki marusa faqa misa ooqumari maru siaqausa faqa mareeqee teeqi taaqi maqinau.
Akaqausa ummaara maree mariasa amaana maqa fiqu fiqu auqira ququsa firuqiaki fimarusa faqa qaoo qufaqa minaki sia fiqau.

Miqimmaseenoo Yisufa quandakinoo miqoo marusa maaqi qimasee qimanniminoo qinau. Ooqeenaa tamummaqara fasiqauqa akaraki Anutufa maa maqanara maaqi qimasee qimaqoofa maridanoo. Qinee faiqí anaasee qini maaqara innaaru qira maqa fee qiaqee qidaqa. Anutufa miqi qimaqoofaqa qinee mimau maaqi qidaqa, innee maqee mariasa maa amaana maqana qumareeqa ummuari mariasa kukeeqara maqaikammi mariafanoo.

Amaana maqakina aanaiqikirausa uriqararausa faqa Mooseena sandufa iriqaraasi marusa faqa Yisufa miqi qunara aanoomasee iriseeqa Yisuna kuqarira aanara randee mariqau. Faiqí anaasee muduka uqanna moomoosa Yisuna ufa irufanoo naaquqoonara aanaiqikirausa Yisunara rufiee marunara ariranara randaqau.
Mi eenaaniannai Yisufa Yeerusaree maqusasaaqari narí faiqi namu nifiqee moosaa finau.
Faafisa fooqaaira saqari aadanusinau.
Faiqee iqaqoofaqa fidaqa misa kafaa mi faafisana fooqaaira saqari aaqa fidaqa qafoofanoo ammuqundari aiqama muqufi oosana amisee aiqama aadanusinoo marinau.

Peetooroofa mina qafamasee tautumasee Yisufa mi saqarina aqunara iriseenoo Yisuna aaramaseenoo qimaminoo qinau. Oo ufasaa rakisirafa anee qafaa anee aqisaananoo doo kuqinoo marinoo qufanoo Yisufa narí faiqi namu qimanniminoo qinau.

Innee maa ufana irisee sia aunuaqa inni irirafa Anutunasaa rusinoo marinaqa innee qifandinna ainainara kuqaa kambiqaannoo fee qiqa sia naunduraki qaara irirana iridaqa innee maa amuaqunamunara rafauruaki ooruku nammariki aqufua qifanoo Anutufa kuqaa aniara miqiannoo.

Minara qinee inni maa ufana faqa qimannimidaqa innee moo ainainara innaaru qidaqa inni irirafa doo mareera foora miqiunoo qimasee irirana Anutunasaa rusisaifanoo aiqama innaaru qimariana Anutufa inni nimiannoo.

Innee inneeqa mandoosana Anutunara minniqisaannee innaaru qidaqa inni mandaikamannimaqaasa misa ummaara aniki marina minnisee aunusaifanoo inni innaarunai nikoofa inni manda oosana akiaqara faqa mininnisaani. [Inni niqoonausa inni mandaikamma nimaqaifaqa inni mina irisee sia mina minnisee kaqi irimaree fifanoo Anutufa faqa innindi faqa miqi kaimmiannoo.]
Yisunara yafee qifanee afeekaikidanee qiqau.

Yisufa kafaa narí faiqi namu faqa Yeerusareenni oorureenoo firaa amaana maqa fiqu fiquira ququsaki keeqafinoo nimarufaqa minakinaana aanaiqikirausa uriqararausa faqa Mooseena sandufa akoofasauqa faqa aniree irammiriqa qiqau.
Oo Yisu anee maa maqanaki bisinisaiki mariasa nifaqasaana fuanara anee uriqarara fee maridanee miqidanee. Yafee aniara qifanee maanaki mariasa nifaqeenee qufanoo Yisufa nári qimanniminoo qinau.
Qinee faqa inniara modaa ufa iramannimaqaanaura. Innee qimaqimifaqa qiniara iraaufana faqa qimannimianauranoo.
Yoohaneefa nammari nimimarufa yafee minara nammari nimianee qufanoo nimimarinau, Anutu fee faiqí fee qufanoo nimimarinau.

Yisufa miqi qimasoofaqa narinni narinni raiqara ufa narí qimami narí qimami qiqau. Maasa naqi fee qianauree. Maasa Yoohaneenara Anutufa qimamiifoo qiananoo mifa maasara nanaree innee Yoohaneena ufara Anutuna ufa fee qimasee mi mau fuaqaana miqidee qiandoora.

Maasa Yoohaneenara faiqí kai qimamiaafoo qianaqa faiqí anaasee kaqiqeesa maasa darifoora misa Yoohaneenara Anutuna tamummaqara fasiqee qimariafa marifaqee qimasee Yisuna qimamiqa qiqau, maasa sia ani ufa anoona irida fee qiqau. Miqi qimasoofanoo Yisufa kafaa nári qimanniminau, Doo amana innee qinindiara sia qimaqimiafaqa qinee faqa innee qiniara yafee qimaminoo fee qianara sia qimannimianaura.
